title: Super Island God VR
description:
Jump into Super Island God and take on the role of a lost island tribe's deity in this exciting new God Simulator. Harness your divine power in this built-for-VR game and reward (or punish) your civilization as they journey through dozens of handcrafted challenges.Features:• Immerse yourself in Virtual Reality and watch your villagers and environment respond in new and novel ways. 

• Direct your villagers across six unique and challenging islands with hidden objectives and time attack modes. 

• Construct and grow your village using unique buildings and an expanding number of villager jobs. 

• Wield your divine powers and cast miracles to reward (or punish) your villagers. 

• Discover hidden toys and easter eggs such as the hungry volcano (feed me...)!

• Unlock unique cosmetic hands by unearthing hidden coins. 

Super Island God is a VR-Only game!
